objective: Represent candidate and promotion history with immutable semantic objects and typed temporal relations while retaining Git topology as a verified transport projection.

semantics.identity: Candidate and promotion objects are independently rooted even when their Git trees are equal.
semantics.derivation: Candidate derivation accepts an explicit semantic dev Cut root independent of Git coordinates; promotion derivation targets the exact candidate provenance object root.
semantics.acknowledgement: Both phases bind an explicit semantic previous-Alpha root through an acknowledges relation without inferring it from Git parentage.
semantics.sourceTree: The source tree is bound by a semantic digest root on the subject while the Git tree object id remains an exact projection coordinate.
semantics.qualification: Qualification is an explicit rooted relation target and is never inferred from a branch, commit, tree, workflow conclusion, or artifact name.
semantics.authority: Exactly one authorized-by relation is required for each object; zero or plural authority is rejected.
semantics.projection: Git commit, tree, parent order, and ancestry are exact rooted observations with explicit drift and no semantic authority.
semantics.appendOnly: A later promotion object references but never rewrites the candidate object.

projectionPolicy.forbiddenInference: Tree equality, ancestry, parent order, merge-queue topology, ff-only delivery, and provider topology never establish semantic derivation or acknowledgement by themselves.

dualWrite.legacyRule: Existing candidate and promotion projections are copied without mutation and retain their exact canonical bytes and root.
